description: Answers a question about the user’s team and funds from Capital Company’s records, or about how Capital Company works — where something is, what a page, a status or an email means, what the product offers, such as its API — from Capital Company’s product guide, with a link to the page when there is one. Answers in Capital Company’s words, only from what the user may see. Changes nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_ask
title: Ask Capital Company
